items.prompt: In a 3 by 3 grid, old cell (row=0,column=1) moves where after one clockwise quarter turn?

options.why: This applies transpose only. Clockwise rotation also reverses the old row coordinate.
The map is (r,c) -> (c,n-1-r), giving (1,2) for n=3.
This reverses the row without exchanging the axes, a reflection rather than this rotation.
The old top-middle cell is not the center. A quarter turn must move it to the right-middle.
